name: Skill Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.x'

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Build solution
        run: dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore

      - name: Run tests
        run: dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build --verbosity normal

      - name: Run skill-validator with metrics
        run: dotnet run --project src/SkillValidator/SkillValidator.csproj -- --metrics

      - name: Generate benchmark data
        run: pwsh ./scripts/generate-benchmark-data.ps1

      - name: Generate token usage data
        run: pwsh ./scripts/generate-token-data.ps1

      - name: Upload token usage artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage
          path: data/token-usage.json

      - name: Upload benchmark artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-data
          path: data/benchmark.json

  publish-dashboard:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download token usage artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: token-usage
          path: data

      - name: Download benchmark artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-data
          path: data

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install dashboard dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build dashboard
        run: npm run build-dashboard

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deploy
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./public
          publish_branch: gh-pages
